description: Brain plugin hooks. The graph-before-grep PreToolUse hook is the §14.5 enforcement layer — it is self-gating (silent unless <cwd>/graphify-out/graph.json exists; the command tests for the graph in the shell so Node starts only where one exists, INNOV-357 — needs sh / Git Bash, the PowerShell fallback cannot parse it), fires once per session, reports graph built_at_commit vs HEAD (graph-first when fresh, advisory otherwise), non-blocking, and is the exact detection signal the §17.2 Track B consumer contract depends on.
